description: Shows the status of a Cambio swap: deposit, confirming, exchanging, payout, each with its time. Needs the order number AND the address the customer is receiving to (the payout address they gave when creating the swap), the same check cambio.one makes. Without that address, no order details are returned.

receiving_address.description: The payout address the customer gave when creating the swap

name: track_swap
title: Track a Cambio swap
